unknownTypeExprs.expr: JsonDataType.mapCodec((element, ops) -> { var json = element.getAsJsonObject(); return new Effect(JsonDataType.required(json, "effect", CalioDataTypes.STATUS_EFFECT_INSTANCE, ops), JsonDataType.field(json, "chance", CalioDataTypes.FLOAT, 1F, ops)); }).codec()

JsonDataType.codec((element, ops) -> { if (!element.isJsonObject()) throw new JsonParseException("Expected a JSON object"); var result = new LinkedHashMap<Identifier, Identifier>(); for (var entry : element.getAsJsonObject().entrySet()) { if (entry.getValue() instanceof JsonPrimitive value && value.isString()) result.put(Identifier.parse(entry.getKey()), Identifier.parse(value.getAsString())); } return result; }, map -> { var json = new JsonObject(); map.forEach((key, value) -> json.addProperty(key.toString(), value.toString())); return json; })

lang.origin.origins.human.name: Human
lang.origin.origins.human.description: A regular human. Your ordinary Minecraft experience awaits.
lang.origin.origins.merling.name: Merling
lang.origin.origins.merling.description: These natural inhabitants of the ocean are not used to being out of the water for too long.
lang.origin.origins.arachnid.name: Arachnid
lang.origin.origins.arachnid.description: Their climbing abilities and the ability to trap their foes in spiderweb make the Arachnid perfect hunters.
lang.origin.origins.blazeborn.name: Blazeborn
lang.origin.origins.blazeborn.description: Late descendants of the Blaze, the Blazeborn are naturally immune to the perils of the Nether.
lang.origin.origins.avian.name: Avian
lang.origin.origins.avian.description: The Avian race has lost their ability to fly a long time ago. Now these peaceful creatures can be seen gliding from one place to another.
lang.origin.origins.phantom.name: Phantom
lang.origin.origins.phantom.description: As half-human and half-phantom beings, these creatures can switch between a Phantom and a normal form.
lang.origin.origins.feline.name: Feline
lang.origin.origins.feline.description: With their cat-like appearance, the Feline scare creepers away. With the dexterity of cats, they always land safely on their feet.
lang.origin.origins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
lang.origin.origins.elytrian.description: Often flying around in the winds, Elytrians are uncomfortable when they don't have enough space above their head.
lang.origin.origins.enderian.name: Enderian
lang.origin.origins.enderian.description: Born as children of the Ender Dragon, Enderians are capable of teleporting but are vulnerable to water.
lang.origin.origins.shulk.name: Shulk
lang.origin.origins.shulk.description: Related to Shulkers, the bodies of the Shulk are outfitted with a protective shell-like skin.
lang.power.origins.water_breathing.name: Gills
lang.power.origins.water_breathing.descriptio: You can breathe underwater, but not on land.
lang.power.origins.aqua_affinity.name: Aqua Affinity
lang.power.origins.aqua_affinity.description: You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.
lang.power.origins.water_vision.name: Wet Eyes
lang.power.origins.swim_speed.name: Fins
lang.power.origins.like_water.name: Like Water
lang.power.origins.like_water.description: When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.
lang.power.origins.fragile.name: Fragile
lang.power.origins.fragile.description: You have 3 less hearts of health than humans.
lang.power.origins.webbing.name: Webbing
lang.power.origins.webbing.description: When you hit an enemy in melee, they get stuck in cobweb.
lang.power.origins.climbing.name: Climbing
lang.power.origins.climbing.description: You are able to climb up any kind of wall, not just ladders.
lang.power.origins.carnivore.name: Carnivore
lang.power.origins.carnivore.description: Your diet is restricted to meat, you can't eat vegetables.
lang.power.origins.fire_immunity.name: Fire Immunity
lang.power.origins.fire_immunity.description: You are immune to all types of fire damage.
lang.power.origins.nether_spawn.name: Nether Inhabitant
lang.power.origins.nether_spawn.description: Your natural spawn will be in the Nether.
lang.power.origins.burning_wrath.name: Burning Wrath
lang.power.origins.burning_wrath.description: When on fire, you deal additional damage with your attacks.
lang.power.origins.hotblooded.name: Hotblooded
lang.power.origins.hotblooded.description: Due to your hot body, venoms burn up, making you immune to poison and hunger status effects.
lang.power.origins.water_vulnerability.name: Hydrophobia
lang.power.origins.water_vulnerability.descri: You receive damage over time while in contact with water.
lang.power.origins.tailwind.name: Tailwind
lang.power.origins.tailwind.description: You are a little bit quicker on foot than others.
lang.power.origins.slow_falling.name: Featherweight
lang.power.origins.slow_falling.description: You fall as gently to the ground as a feather would, unless you sneak.
lang.power.origins.vegetarian.name: Vegetarian
lang.power.origins.fresh_air.name: Fresh Air
lang.power.origins.fresh_air.description: When sleeping, your bed needs to be at an altitude of at least 86 blocks, so you can breathe fresh air.
lang.power.origins.phasing.name: Phasing
lang.power.origins.phasing.description: While phantomized, you can walk through solid material, except Obsidian.
lang.power.origins.invisibility.name: Invisibility
lang.power.origins.hunger_over_time.name: Fast Metabolism
lang.power.origins.hunger_over_time.descripti: Being phantomized causes you to become hungry.
lang.power.origins.burn_in_daylight.name: Photoallergic
lang.power.origins.burn_in_daylight.descripti: You begin to burn in daylight if you are not invisible.
lang.power.origins.fall_immunity.name: Acrobatics
lang.power.origins.fall_immunity.description: You never take fall damage, no matter from which height you fall.
lang.power.origins.sprint_jump.name: Strong Ankles
lang.power.origins.sprint_jump.description: You are able to jump higher by jumping while sprinting.
lang.power.origins.nine_lives.name: Nine Lives
lang.power.origins.nine_lives.description: You have 1 less heart of health than humans.
lang.power.origins.cat_vision.name: Nocturnal
lang.power.origins.cat_vision.description: You can slightly see in the dark when not in water.
lang.power.origins.weak_arms.name: Weak Arms
lang.power.origins.weak_arms.description: When not under the effect of a strength potion, you can only mine natural stone if there are at most 2 other natural stone blocks adjacent to it.
lang.power.origins.scare_creepers.name: Catlike Appearance
lang.power.origins.scare_creepers.description: Creepers are scared of you and will only explode if you attack them first.
lang.power.origins.launch_into_air.name: Gift of the Winds
lang.power.origins.launch_into_air.descriptio: Every 30 seconds, you are able to launch about 20 blocks up into the air.
lang.power.origins.elytra.name: Winged
lang.power.origins.elytra.description: You have Elytra wings without needing to equip any.
lang.power.origins.light_armor.name: Need for Mobility
lang.power.origins.light_armor.description: You can not wear any heavy armor (armor with protection values higher than chainmail).
lang.power.origins.claustrophobia.name: Claustrophobia
lang.power.origins.claustrophobia.description: Being somewhere with a low ceiling for too long will weaken you and make you slower.
lang.power.origins.more_kinetic_damage.name: Brittle Bones
lang.power.origins.more_kinetic_damage.descri: You take more damage from falling and flying into blocks.
lang.power.origins.aerial_combatant.name: Aerial Combatant
lang.power.origins.aerial_combatant.descripti: You deal substantially more damage while in Elytra flight.
lang.power.origins.throw_ender_pearl.name: Teleportation
lang.power.origins.throw_ender_pearl.descript: Whenever you want, you may throw an ender pearl which deals no damage, allowing you to teleport.
lang.power.origins.pumpkin_hate.name: Scared of Gourds
lang.power.origins.pumpkin_hate.description: You are afraid of pumpkins. For a good reason.
lang.power.origins.extra_reach.name: Slender Body
lang.power.origins.extra_reach.description: You can reach blocks and entities further away.
lang.power.origins.shulker_inventory.name: Hoarder
lang.power.origins.shulker_inventory.descript: You have access to an additional 9 slots of inventory, which keep the items on death.
lang.power.origins.natural_armor.name: Sturdy Skin
lang.power.origins.natural_armor.description: Even without wearing armor, your skin provides natural protection.
lang.power.origins.more_exhaustion.name: Large Appetite
lang.power.origins.more_exhaustion.descriptio: You exhaust much quicker than others, thus requiring you to eat more.
lang.power.origins.no_shield.name: Unwieldy
lang.power.origins.no_shield.description: The way your hands are formed provide no way of holding a shield upright.
lang.power.origins.strong_arms.name: Strong Arms
lang.power.origins.strong_arms.description: You are strong enough to break natural stones without using a pickaxe.
lang.power.origins.translucent.name: Translucent
lang.power.origins.end_spawn.name: End Inhabitant
lang.power.origins.end_spawn.description: Your journey begins in the End.
lang.power.origins.master_of_webs.name: Master of Webs
lang.power.origins.master_of_webs.description: You navigate cobweb perfectly, and are able to climb in them. When you hit an enemy in melee, they get stuck in cobweb for a while. Non-arthropods stuck in cobweb will be sensed by you. You are able to craft cobweb from string.
lang.power.origins.lay_eggs.name: Oviparous
lang.power.origins.lay_eggs.description: Whenever you wake up in the morning, you will lay an egg.
lang.power.origins.phantomize.name: Phantom Form
lang.power.origins.phantomize.description: You can switch between human and phantom form at will, but only while you are saturated enough to sprint.
lang.power.origins.like_air.name: Like Air
lang.power.origins.like_air.description: Modifiers to your walking speed also apply while you're airborne.
lang.power.origins.velvet_paws.name: Velvet Paws
lang.power.origins.velvet_paws.description: Your footsteps don't cause any vibrations which could otherwise be picked up by nearby lifeforms.
lang.origin.origins.random.name: Random
lang.origin.origins.random.description: You'll be assigned one of the following:
lang.layer.origins.origin.name: Origin
lang.origin.origins.empty.name: Missing
lang.origin.origins.empty.description: You do not have an Origin.
